description_en: Pay attention to your steps while walking. Tap the screen to the beat to record your walking rhythm.
description_zh: 行走時留意自己的步伐，以打拍子的點觸方式，留下您走路的節奏。
wellness_message_zh: 步伐節奏往往反映內在心理狀態。透過留意自己的腳步聲與行走速度，可察覺是否過於急促，並為自我調節創造空間，有助減低緊張感與提升身心覺察。
wellness_message_en: Walking pace reflects mental state. Listening to footsteps reveals urgency and creates space for regulation.
address_zh: 港鐵站(鰂魚涌)、港鐵站(會展)、港鐵站(大埔墟)、港鐵站(錦上路)、港鐵站(荃灣)
address_en: MTR(Quarry Bay), MTR(Exhibition Centre), MTR(Tai Po Market), MTR(Kam Sheung Road), MTR(Tsuen Wan)

parameter.message_zh:
您留意到自己的節奏。
覺察本身，已是一種調節。
parameter.message_en: Awareness itself is regulation.

description_en: Listen to the ambient background noise and choose the feeling it brings to you.
description_zh: 聆聽環境背景聲，選擇它帶來的感受。
wellness_message_zh: 穩定而持續的背景聲，能為大腦提供安全感。短暫留意車廂或站內的環境白噪音，有助降低過度刺激，讓神經系統獲得片刻休息與平靜。
wellness_message_en: Stable background sounds provide safety and calm the nervous system.
address_zh: 港鐵站(粉嶺)、港鐵站(鑽石山)、港鐵站(顯徑)、港鐵站(調景嶺)、港鐵站(沙田圍)

parameter.message_zh:

description_en: Notice the texture or temperature of the object in your hand, and select what you feel.
description_zh: 留意手上物品觸感或溫度，選擇您的感受。
wellness_message_zh: 觸覺是最直接連結身體與當下的感官。透過留意物件的溫度與質感，可將注意力由思緒拉回身體，建立即時的存在感，並有助提升穩定與安定感。
wellness_message_en: Touch anchors attention in the body. Noticing temperature supports stability.
address_zh: 港鐵站(上水)、港鐵站(荔枝角)、港鐵站(車公廟)、港鐵站(石硤尾)、港鐵站(九龍灣)

wellness_message_zh: 空氣的轉換往往反映空間與環境的改變。透過留意空氣感覺的差異，有助提升對場景轉移的覺察，並提醒自己正在進入新的情境與狀態。

wellness_message_zh: 嗅覺與情緒記憶關係密切。某些熟悉氣味能迅速喚起過往經驗，透過覺察這種反應，有助理解自身情緒來源，並加深對內在狀態的認識。
wellness_message_en: Smell links to memory and emotion. Familiar scents clarify feelings.

wellness_message_en: Conscious breathing regulates mind and body.

description_en: Start the mission by tapping “Start Tracking.” Walk naturally around the mall and let the distance accumulate automatically. Once the required distance is reached, the system will display the completion screen. Tap “Complete Mission” to save your progress. There is no need to walk faster—simply focus on the act of walking itself.
description_zh:
任務點開始，按下「開始追蹤」，於商場內自然步行即可累積距離。

無需加快步伐，專注行走本身。

description_en: In this mission, you will write a letter to yourself one year from now. You may type your thoughts, your current state, or moments you wish your future self to remember. You can also write about your goals, present feelings, or words you wish to say to your future self. Once completed, the letter will be saved and sent.

您可以打字，記下此刻的您正在想的事，
正在經歷的狀態，或者您希望未來的自己
仍然記得的畫面與細節。

您也可以寫下：對未來的目標或方向
現在的感受與想法
想對未來的自己說的話

description_en:
In the fast pace of city life, eating often becomes just another task to finish quickly.330day invites you to pause, even in a familiar dining setting.
Through sight, smell, sound, taste, and touch, rediscover the moment of focus a bowl of Mixian can bring.This experience has no time limit and requires no change in choice—simply move through each step at your own pace.
Let one meal become a small pause, and a moment of reconnection with yourself.
description_zh: 在城市的日常節奏中，飲食往往只是其中一個被快速完成的環節。330day 邀請您，在熟悉的用餐場景中，暫停一下腳步。透過視覺、嗅覺、聽覺、味覺與觸覺，重新感受一碗米線帶來的專注片刻。這次體驗不設時間限制，也無需改變選擇，只需按自己的節奏完成每一個步驟。讓一餐，成為與自己連結的微小休息。
address_zh: 所有譚仔分店
address_en: All TamJai Shop

parameter.message_zh:
您已完成五感慢食之旅
飲食內容沒有改變，改變的是進食時的專注程度。
parameter.message_en:
You Have Completed the Five-Senses Dining Journey 
The food itself hasn’t changed.What changed is the level of attention while eating.
